newsitem.title: USA: Magda Gabor, sister of Zsa Zsa and Eva, dies.
newsitem.headline: Magda Gabor, sister of Zsa Zsa and Eva, dies.

text.p: Magda Gabor, the sister of actresses Zsa Zsa and the late Eva Gabor, died on Friday in a California hospital, a publicist said. She was 78.
She said Gabor died of kidney failure in the Eisenhower Medical Centre in Rancho Mirage.
"Zsa Zsa is very broken up about it, especially after their mother passed away only recently," said publicist Miriam Levin.
Jolie Gabor, mother of the three Hungarian-born Gabor sisters, died on April 1 this year at age 97. Eva Gabor, best known for the TV show "Green Acres", died on July 4, 1995.
Unlike her sisters, Magda Gabor only had a brief acting career. She lived most of her life in New York.
She was a widow and had no children.
